Text: The loyalty service shall expire posted points 12 months after posting.
Rationale: Limits the points liability on the balance sheet (SH-03).

Text: The loyalty service should notify members about expiring points in a timely manner.
Rationale: Softens the effect of the 12-month expiry.

Text: IF a member returns a purchase after its points were redeemed, the loyalty service shall handle the negative balance.
The admin console shall let support agents adjust a member's points.
Rationale: Support resolves complaints about missing points.
